name: Deploy over SSH
description: Ship a project to a host over SSH and keep it running, whatever shape the thing is
phrasings: push this live on the vps
send this to the cloud node
run this on the remote host
get this running on the server
stand this up on the remote box

params.name: target
params.desc: local or cloud deploy target name

prompt: Deploy {project} using the ssh-deploy pack. Run `t3 deploy list --project {project}` first; if no targets exist, ask which one before doing anything.
